pages.title: Entropy
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks stack entropy marks; 2 stacks slow the target by 15%; at 3 stacks it detonates for true damage equal to 30% of the target's lost health, and spreads 50% of that damage to hostile mobs within 8 blocks.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
